text:
Every Dallas shift involving Jamie Benn tonight comes with extra noise. The captain is one point from 1,000 for his career, all of it with the Stars, a franchise he has carried through the end of one era and into the next. Milestones are not something our numbers try to price, and they shouldn't. They are just the best part of a regular-season Thursday.

The Stars have had five days off, which helps a team missing Miro Heiskanen (upper body) for at least one more game. Thomas Harley has taken over the top power play and Tyler Myers is up to about 20 minutes a night. Dallas has been tidy rather than loud: 52% of the five-on-five expected goals, the quality of the chances, 2.29 goals allowed a game, and a penalty kill allowing only 0.56 expected goals a game. Jake Oettinger is 7.7 goals saved above expected. Wyatt Johnston and Mikko Rantanen both carry five-game point streaks, and Jason Robertson, whose future in Dallas keeps drawing insider chatter, recently scored the third-fastest hat trick in franchise history, per NHL.com's Tom Gulitti.

Winnipeg is the more interesting team on paper right now. The Jets have won four straight, outscoring teams 19-11 with 62% of the expected goals in those games, and the chances back it. They also have reason to think their record is too harsh: a -12 goal difference on -4.8 expected, with finishing 6.6 goals below what their chances usually produce. Mark Scheifele has points in four straight, including the last-second power-play winner against Tampa Bay. Stuart Skinner, in his first season after the blockbuster trade that sent Connor Hellebuyck to New Jersey, sits at .883 and almost exactly average by expected goals.

Dallas won the first meeting 3-2 in overtime on Oct. 22 and deserved it in 69% of replays (the share of simulated games, from every shot, a team wins). Our Sleeper is Tyler Seguin, a third-liner with 2.9 expected goals in his last ten; we give him a 21% chance to score. Our numbers have Dallas at 3.22 expected goals and Winnipeg at 2.66.
headline: Jamie Benn, one point from 1,000
